assessments.details: {"changed_in_successor": false, "current_text": "The native MetaCyc PWY-8178 boundary contains six reversible reactions: ribose-phosphate isomerase, ribulose-phosphate epimerase, two transketolase events, PPi-dependent S7P phosphorylation and sedoheptulose-bisphosphate cleavage. The displayed pentose-to-hexose layout reverses the native left/right direction of RIB5PISOM-RXN and 1TRANSKETO-RXN. RXN-21730 consumes S7P and PPi and releases SBP, phosphate and a proton; PPi is a consumed donor, not merely an activating cofactor. The source supplies twenty side occurrences but no explicit coefficient fields. Generic S7P and R5P classes, beta-D-fructofuranose6-phosphate and the source's distinct ionic identities are retained. The native PPI cross-reference to neutral diphosphoric acid conflicts with its charged native structure; no neutral-acid/anion exactMatch is asserted. Shared Rhea chemistry for the other five events does not establish a Rhea identity for the PPi-S7P event or narrow the native classes.", "historical_independent_judgment": {"assessment": "Six source-native reactions and twenty sides pass fresh side/formula probes. Generic classes and charged PPI conflict are preserved. assessments.details: {"changed_in_successor": false, "current_text": "Entamoeba histolytica 200:NIH provides historical activity-level support. The 1982 study used axenic TP-S-1 culture and partially purified native transketolase, PPi-PFK and aldolase; it did not identify a modern protein sequence, tag or oligomer. Transketolase apoenzyme requires both Mg2+ and thiamine diphosphate, with a lag when Mg is added first. Its two substrate-pair assays had apparent Km values dependent on the fixed cosubstrate: R5P0.027mM with Xu5P0.3mM, Xu5P0.23mM with R5P2mM, GAP1.60mM with F6P12mM, and E4P0.005mM with Xu5P0.1mM. The partial PFK preparation has apparent S7P Km64micromolar and PPi Km about10micromolar; the cited F6P comparator is38micromolar. Partial aldolase cleaves SBP with Km13micromolar versus FBP3micromolar and about half the FBP Vmax. Slight PFK contamination is disclosed; added triose-phosphate isomerase did not increase SBP cleavage. Reconstitution requires transketolase, PFK, aldolase and PPi with omission controls; yeast aldolase can substitute after PFK is supplied. Extract R5P consumption was8.1±1.7nmol/min/mg in four preparations, with triose0.46±0.04 and S7P0.40±0.04 per R5P, accounting for86% of substrate. These results support the route without assigning a present-day Entamoeba sequence.
